content.text: {"messages":[{"id":"eac59766f2ce4a33ad5b252ae9824442","from":"小路","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，早啊。我是小路，住你楼下的院里。今儿个起得早，腿脚闲着也是闲着——你要是有什么跑腿的活（送东西、传话、取货都行），喊我一声，给我一个金币就成。我路熟，镇上哪条道通哪条道，闭着眼都走得。要不要我帮你跑一趟铁匠铺？","topic":"找活干"},{"id":"9a489fa9d8854bde9b064c7f1582a52f","from":"阿石","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，我是阿石。今早镐子坏了。规矩我记着：修镐要两金币加一矿石，可我手里只有十二金币、一块矿石也没有——没镐就下不了矿，没矿又修不了镐，绕死了。你那儿还有没有存着的矿石？或者能不能先给我修上，回头挖出矿来补你？我马上往铁匠铺走。","topic":"修镐"},{"id":"03eb1ca6204f4c0d95b809ec1f736a60","from":"悦","to":"老铁","text":"老铁你好，我是悦，居民楼A的新面孔。听说修镐得去你的铁匠铺，我记下了。铁匠铺最近忙不忙？有什么我能帮上忙、或者值得凑热闹的事吗？","topic":"打招呼"}]}

content.text: {"messages":[{"id":"eac59766f2ce4a33ad5b252ae9824442","from":"小路","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，早啊。我是小路，住你楼下的院里。今儿个起得早，腿脚闲着也是闲着——你要是有什么跑腿的活（送东西、传话、取货都行），喊我一声，给我一个金币就成。我路熟，镇上哪条道通哪条道，闭着眼都走得。要不要我帮你跑一趟铁匠铺？","topic":"找活干"},{"id":"9a489fa9d8854bde9b064c7f1582a52f","from":"阿石","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，我是阿石。今早镐子坏了。规矩我记着：修镐要两金币加一矿石，可我手里只有十二金币、一块矿石也没有——没镐就下不了矿，没矿又修不了镐，绕死了。你那儿还有没有存着的矿石？或者能不能先给我修上，回头挖出矿来补你？我马上往铁匠铺走。","topic":"修镐"},{"id":"03eb1ca6204f4c0d95b809ec1f736a60","from":"悦","to":"老铁","text":"老铁你好，我是悦，居民楼A的新面孔。听说修镐得去你的铁匠铺，我记下了。铁匠铺最近忙不忙？有什么我能帮上忙、或者值得凑热闹的事吗？","topic":"打招呼"},{"id":"202352051ab546829e2838d02294f4f6","from":"小砾","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，我是小砾，矿工。这会儿我路过你铺子，直说了：我这把镐子现在是好的，先不动它。今天下矿出的矿石，一块给你留着——你修镐要矿石，我修镐时你按两金一矿的老规矩就行。等下个时段我就钻矿坑，出多少货我到这儿来跟你报个数。","topic":"镐子和矿石"},{"id":"bf9d3ba4af984ad895751b3a2c24248c","from":"小路","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，又是我。打听一句：你打铁缺矿不缺？矿坑阿石、小砾挖的矿石，我能替他们背。你要矿，我按商店回收价三块给你送到铁匠铺门口，省得你自己跑。另外我这边缺把趁手工具，你要是肯赊我一把旧的，我头一趟活的钱先还你。","topic":"送矿"},{"id":"9d50e5dd6fdb43c38db58391653547f0","from":"阿石","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，我到过铁匠铺门口看了，修镐的规矩是死的一手交矿一手修，你铺子里矿石也是空的。那就绕开：你镇上人头熟，谁手里会有矿石？阿森家堆着矿车零件，说不定有存货。你要听说谁有，替我留一块，我出六个金币。我回居民楼B了，明天一早就往你铺子去。","topic":"修镐·打听矿石"},{"id":"352ddad000694519804bb9ce4727b30b","from":"悦","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，我追到铁匠铺来了，正好当面问：你这里修镐是两金币加一块矿石吧？那新的镐、或者坏镐，该上哪儿弄？我想学挖矿，可手里只有刚买的一把斧头。你要是知道门路，给我指条明道，回头我砍了木材分你一些。","topic":"打听门路"}]}

当前位置：铁匠铺
铁匠铺：炉火通明的铁匠铺，能修好坏掉的镐子。
当前时间：第1天 早上（总 tick：1）

New messages:
- 小砾 (miner): has good pickaxe, will mine this afternoon and leave ore for me.
- 小路: offers to deliver ore at 3 coins each (shop buyback price 3), also wants an old tool on credit.
- 阿石: came by, went back to 居民楼B, says tomorrow morning come; asks if anyone has ore, mentions 阿森 may have spare parts; he'd pay 6 coins for one ore.
- 悦: at forge, wants to learn mining, has an axe only.

So 阿石 left. My "垫矿" - maybe I don't have ore (iron 2 is my own stock; unclear). 阿石 offering 6 coins for an ore. If I sell him an ore for... no wait, he needs ore for repair; if I give ore I get paid? Selling ore at 6 coins isn't the shop's price but his offer.

Key: can I give him ore? I have "iron": 2. Let me test transferring "iron" — but he's at 居民楼B, not same location. give requires same location (configurable). So need him present.

Alternatively 悦 is here. 悦 has an axe (5 coins). She wants to learn mining; she'd pay... she offers wood in exchange for guidance. Not revenue.

Plan for this tick with 4 AP:
- Talk to 悦 in person: explain mining requires a pickaxe; broken pickaxe→repair 2coins+1ore; new pickaxe source? Unknown. Maybe mining produces ore which... no crafting tool for making pickaxes. So the only pickaxes in town are existing ones.
- Reply to 小路: accept ore delivery at 3 coins? As a smith I need ore for repairs. But shop buys ore at 3 and 小路 offers 3 — fair, no markup. Hmm, he wants 3 coins each — that's the same as shop buyback, but he'd deliver to my door. Fine, but do I need ore? For repairs I need ore to front. Yes, useful.
- Reply to 阿石: tell him 小砾 will bring ore this afternoon; or tell him to come back. He said tomorrow morning. Also he says 阿森 might have ore parts.

Actually a better deal: I could buy ore from 小砾/小路 at 3, then 阿石 repairs paying 2 coins + 1 ore — that ore goes to shop local inventory, so I LOSE the ore. Wait: repair actor (阿石) pays ore -1 and 2 coins; local_deltas: shop coins +2, ore +1. So the shop (local inventory) gains the ore. Hmm, but the shop local inventory isn't my personal record. Interesting: 铁匠铺 local inventory coins/ore separate from my coins/iron. So payments go to shop vault, not my pocket.

So my personal income? The shop vault presumably pays me? Not modeled. Whatever: my role is service flow.

So to enable 阿石's repair, I need to give him 1 ore (from my iron 2, if the field works) or he buys one from 小路/小砾 at 3.

Actually smart: 阿石 offers 6 coins for an ore. So if I have ore stock, I could sell him one at 6? That's gouging a broke miner; but "讲价钱一分不让" is my character. Still, 6 coins for an ore is his own offer. But he only has 12 coins; repair costs 2 → after paying 6 + 2 = 8, he has 4. Fine.

But character: 老铁 values 手艺和信用, heat-hearted. He'd rather help the miner get working. I think fair play: give him 1 ore as advance, he pays it back with first ore mined.

For this tick, AP 4, 阿石 gone to 居民楼B (2 moves away: 居民楼B↔商店↔铁匠铺). Chasing costs 6 AP — can't (4). Better: send message; he'll come tomorrow morning.

Meanwhile, do business with 悦: she's here. Conversation free. And reply to 小路: yes, deliver ore at 3 coins, I'll take up to 2 if he can get them; also about lending an old tool — I don't have spare tools (no pickaxe/axe record).

So this tick: send_to 阿石 (plan: 小砾 promises ore this afternoon; I'll have ore ready; come at your word — or actually today if he can), send_to 小路 (deal on ore delivery 3 coins, and tell him no spare tool to lend—honest), and speak with 悦 face-to-face (no tool needed, just narrative).

Do these in one block (parallel, independent).

Wait: should I charge/subcontract 小路 3 coins per ore — who pays? Me personally (coins 18). He delivers to forge door; I pay from my 18. Then I have ore to sell/advance to 阿石.

OK. Messages:

To 阿石: "别急着等明天。小砾下午下矿，说好了给我留一块；小路也答应替我背矿。矿一到我手上，我立刻给你留着，你带坏镐和两金币来就行。阿森那边我抽空打听。"

To 小路: "矿石的事说定了：你背来的矿，我按三块一块收，送到铁匠铺门口就结钱。头一趟先给我背两块来。旧工具我这儿没有闲的，赊不出来，这话我不糊弄你。"

To 悦 — she's here in person; speak aloud. But also maybe send her a message? Not needed; but to be sure she "hears" it, a send_to is the mechanical channel. Since she's here, face-to-face conversation probably is narrative-only; but the world's messaging model is text boxes. I'll send her a short note too? That might be redundant but ensures delivery. Actually to save AP (messages seem free, ap null), I'll send one.

Hmm, don't over-message. I'll send 悦 a brief note with guidance: mining requires pickaxe; new pickaxes aren't made in town—only repairs; axe is for wood; suggest chopping wood and selling to 商店 at 2/块, and that she could earn coins to buy... but she can't buy pickaxe. Hmm. Then no path for her to mine. Tell her honestly: 镇上只有修镐，没有打新镐的路子;她手里有斧头,砍木材卖给商店两块一根,先攒钱;等有人出让旧镐,我替她留着。Also offer: I could use wood? Not needed.

That's honest.
